text:
alexander: :rotating_light: alert from synths — ZetaCorp PrivateLink endpoint (nebula-euc1) showing elevated TCP RSTs and DNS NXDOMAIN spikes for ~10 mins. Observed 50% of requests failing with connection timeout. Noticing route flaps in the gateway AS path.

incident-bot: Escalation triggered — paging oncall. Pager: mira (primary oncall).

mira: on it. grabbing logs and hitting the endpoints now. alex, can you share which customers impacted?

alexander: ZetaCorp primary, 2 other customers with peering to same AZ saw intermittent failures (no complete outage). Impact: API calls to our private host timing out; customer retries see 503s.

sanjay: I'm seeing BGP withdraws from peer 203.0.113.5 -> flapping every ~20s. AS path weirdness: neighbor prepends then withdraws. Could be partner edge.

mira: thanks. running quick traceroute to nebula-euc1 from our infra: \n```\ntraceroute nebula-zeta.euc1.redwood: 1 10.0.0.1 0.5ms 0.4ms 0.4ms
2 198.51.100.2 12.0ms 11.9ms 12.1ms
3 203.0.113.5 * 14.8ms *  <-- toggling
4 203.0.113.9 15.2ms 15.1ms 15.3ms
```\n
mira: hop 3 is jittering/blackholing intermittently. net-bot, can you confirm peer-side metrics?

net-bot: Partner VX reported BFD down events at 1745559600 and 1745559660. BGP flaps present. Ticket opened with partner NOC: PRJ-4781.

kim: cc @customer-success — we should prepare a customer note. Olivia, can you draft a short advisory saying degraded network reachability to PrivateLink nebula-euc1; we'll follow up with root cause and ETA?

olivia: on it. Draft: "We're investigating intermittent connectivity to your PrivateLink endpoint in EU-C1. Some traffic is being affected by upstream route instability; we are working with the network partner to mitigate. We'll update in 15 minutes." Want me to send now?

alexander: send now, but mark as 'investigating' and include suggested workaround: direct traffic to standby endpoint in euc2 for critical flows.

olivia: sent to ZetaCorp (internal ref: INC-4521). They asked if we can failover for them.

mira: action plan: 1) Confirm partner NOC mitigation 2) Add temporary route preference to prefer euc2 path for ZetaCorp (failover) 3) If still unstable, apply AS-path prepend filter on our side to steer away. I'll take step 2 now.

sanjay: doing a quick risk check — failover to euc2 for ZetaCorp will add ~20ms latency but keeps requests healthy. Agreed.

mira: applying route override for prefix 198.51.100.0/24 -> prefer nebula-euc2 via local policy (will keep for 30m). Command: \n```\nnet policy set -p 198.51.100.0/24 --prefer-region euc2 --ttl 1800 --dry-run=false
```\n
mira: applied. Canary test to ZetaCorp endpoints shows stable connections now (0% RSTs over 2 mins).

alexander: good. Can we confirm DNS negative caching wasn't making things worse? Some clients reported NXDOMAIN then cached.

sanjay: checked authoritative zone for nebula-euc1 — no changes on our side. But edge resolver returned SERVFAIL when route was blackholed, leading to negative caching TTL of ~300s. That explains some persistent failures.

olivia: informing ZetaCorp: we applied a temporary failover to EU-C2 to restore traffic; upstream provider working on BGP flap. Suggested they clear DNS cache or respect TTL ~300s — they acknowledged.

incident-bot: oncall handover pending in 30m. mira please update before handoff.

mira: will monitor for 20 mins. If partner confirms stable BGP for 10m, I'll remove override and let traffic return. If not, keep failover and escalate.

customer-success: ZetaCorp seq: "App returned to normal after 2 mins of failover. Thanks team." (reacted :white_check_mark:)

net-bot: Partner NOC update: PRJ-4781 — found misconfiguration on provider transit: BFD session flapped due to MTU mismatch after maintenance. Fix pushed at 1745560300, monitoring.

mira: partner says fix pushed. Starting to revert policy in 5 mins to test.

mira: reverting route override now (rolling back the 30m policy). Command: \n```\nnet policy delete -p 198.51.100.0/24 --policy-id 5892
```\n
mira: reverting — running canary. 30s test shows stable BGP, no withdraws, DNS responses normal.

alexander: excellent. leaving final note: root cause appears to be partner transit MTU mismatch causing BFD flaps -> BGP withdraws -> intermittent blackholing and downstream DNS SERVFAIL negative cache. Mitigation: temporary route steer to euc2 and partner fixed MTU.

mira: I'll close incident if no regressions in next 15m and file postmortem with net team and partner action items (checklist: add MTU validation to maintenance playbook, lower negative TTL for private DNS, automated failover policy test).

incident-bot: Incident marked as 'mitigated' at 1745560800. Please file the postmortem doc and tag `net/postmortems`.

olivia: drafting post-incident customer summary and PM notes now.

alexander: thanks all. moving to standby. (reacted :thumbsup:)
